subject: Proposal: ISV Synergy — LangChain/LlamaIndex Tracing + Prompt Tooling Pilot
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Carina Patel <carina@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: ISV Synergy — LangChain/LlamaIndex Tracing + Prompt Tooling Pilot

Hi Carina —

Great meeting last week. As discussed, Orbit Labs' prompting/observability customers map closely to the workloads where Redwood's tracing + prompt tooling can reduce token cost and surface regressions earlier. I attached a short SOW and a telemetry spec that outline a two-month pilot:

- Week 1: sandbox kickoff, access and data contracts
- Weeks 2–5: instrumentation + tracing hooks (LangChain & LlamaIndex adapters)
- Weeks 6–7: joint evals on 3 production prompt sets + latency/cost baseline
- Week 8: review, ROI write-up, decision on go/no-go and co-marketing

Key asks from Orbit: access to a non-prod integration customer (anonymized logs), a technical owner for SDK changes, and a short NDA amendment to permit shared telemetry.

Attachments: redwood-orbit-integration-sow-v1.pdf, telemetry-spec-v1.xlsx

Proposed next step: I can send a one-page mutual action plan and DocuSign for the SOW. Let me know if you want any scope trimmed (e.g., drop the LlamaIndex adapter in week 2 to compress schedule).

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Carina Patel <carina@orbitlabs.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@orbitlabs.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 12:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: ISV Synergy — LangChain/LlamaIndex Tracing + Prompt Tooling Pilot

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear plan and the SOW. This looks promising and matches our goals for the quarter. Quick responses to your asks:

- We can provide a pseudonymized non-prod dataset and a tech lead (Samir Khan) to work on the adapters.
- NDA amendment is fine; legal will sign the standard addition.
- On scope: we prefer to keep both LangChain and LlamaIndex in the pilot if possible — it helps our enterprise customers who use both. If we need to compress, we can parallelize some instrumentation tasks.

Two questions before we sign:
1) Any expected PII surface when shipping KV cache traces? We need explicit controls.
2) Do you offer a supported fallback model if the instrumented models exceed latency SLOs during the eval?

If those are okay, I can route the SOW and amendment through our legal today and aim to return signed within 48 hours.

Best,
Carina
Head of Ecosystem, Orbit Labs
carina@orbitlabs.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: ISV Synergy — LangChain/LlamaIndex Tracing + Prompt Tooling Pilot

Internal —

Carina is aligned and legal wants two clarifications before signing: PII controls on KV traces and fallback model behavior for latency SLO breaches. Can we split responses: Vanessa, can you confirm telemetry privacy controls (redaction, sampling, retention) we will promise in the amendment? Kimberly, can you confirm which model variants we can automatically route to as a fallback and what configuration is safe to propose (quantized vs fp16)? Marissa — please draft a conservative timeline for parallelizing LangChain + LlamaIndex instrumentation so we can propose compressed weeks if Orbit requests it.

I want a 1-pager response by EOD tomorrow so I can attach to the SOW and route back.

Thanks —
Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Carina Patel <carina@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: ISV Synergy — LangChain/LlamaIndex Tracing + Prompt Tooling Pilot

Carina —

Thanks for the quick reply and for lining up Samir. Answers to your questions (summary):

1) PII surface: Redwood will not persist raw PII in telemetry. Our telemetry-spec (attached) documents redaction rules, hashing of user identifiers, and a 30-day rolling retention for raw traces. We can shorten retention to 7 days for the pilot if preferred and apply an additional sampling rate to reduce egress of sensitive tokens.

2) Fallback model behavior: for the pilot we propose a configurable fallback policy that routes to a quantized variant of the same family (Q4 or INT8) with a soft-latency threshold of 300ms. If latency still exceeds target, requests will be routed to a smaller architecturally-compatible model (we list the exact variants in the SOW appendix). All routing decisions will be logged and visible in the console.

Actions and next steps:
- I attached the updated SOW (redwood-orbit-integration-sow-v1.pdf) and telemetry-spec-v1.xlsx.
- Legal: DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/link/Sign-Redwood-Orbit-POC
- Drive: integration draft and runbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cIntegrationDraft

If Orbit legal signs the amendment, we can start sandbox access provisioning within 3 business days. Looking forward —

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
